# Prime Graphics

> Prime Graphics makes custom patches — embroidered patches, PVC (rubber) patches, leather patches and sublimation (full-colour printed) patches — for brands, teams, clubs and businesses in the UK, USA and worldwide. We also provide embroidery digitizing, vector art conversion and laser engraving designs for embroidery, print and engraving shops.

Key facts:
- Main service: custom patches with your logo — embroidered, PVC, leather and sublimation — for hats, uniforms, jackets, bags, clubs and merchandise. Free design mock-up and quote. All common backings (sew-on, iron-on, Velcro/hook and loop, adhesive and more). Minimum order and production time depend on patch type and size. Ships worldwide.
- Embroidery digitizing: left chest logos $9–12, jacket backs $12–50 (USD). Files: EMB, DST, PDF, BMP/JPG; other formats (PES, EXP, JEF, VP3…) on request.
- Vector art: raster to vector conversion $9–12, digital vector art $14–50 (USD).
- Turnaround for digitizing and vector files: about 4 hours, about 2 hours for rush orders. Free small edits and revisions, bulk discounts, free trial on the first simple order.
- Payment: PayPal, credit and debit cards.
- Address: 5 Carlisle St, Soho, London W1D 3BJ, United Kingdom.
- Contact: primeservice903@gmail.com · +44 7429 915781
- Serves: United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia and worldwide.
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100083557743100 · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/prime_graphics269

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.theprimegraphics.com/): custom patches and design services overview, galleries, client testimonials, packages and FAQ
- [Custom patches](https://www.theprimegraphics.com/embroidery-patch): custom embroidered patches, custom leather patches, custom PVC (rubber) patches and custom sublimation (full-colour printed) patches for hats, jackets, uniforms and brands, with iron-on, Velcro, sew-on or adhesive backing; galleries and FAQ
- [Embroidery digitizing, vector art and engraving design services](https://www.theprimegraphics.com/services): logo, cap and 3D puff digitizing (UK spelling: digitising) with DST/EMB files; hand-redrawn raster to vector conversion (vectorise / vectorize a logo); laser engraving designs; prices and FAQ

## How to order
- Email the logo or artwork, size, quantity and patch type (or file format for digitizing) to primeservice903@gmail.com, or call +44 7429 915781.
- Prime Graphics replies with a free quote (and a free design mock-up for patches) and starts once the design is approved.
- For custom patches, the minimum order, price, production time and delivery time depend on the patch type, size and quantity and are confirmed in the quote.
